name: pledr-legal
description: Search Supreme Court of India judgments and get citations, paragraph numbers and links to the official PDF.

interface.longDescription:
Pledr Legal lets ChatGPT search Supreme Court of India judgments (2016 to 2026) and answer with citable case law.

Describe a legal scenario, name a statute or section (for example Section 438 CrPC), or give a case citation (for example 2018 INSC 880). Pledr returns relevant passages from matching judgments, each with:
- the citation, case number, parties and judgment date
- the paragraph number(s) the passage comes from
- the passage text, taken directly from the judgment
- a link to the official judgment PDF on the Supreme Court of India website
- a short case summary (issue, held, ratio)

Pledr is read-only. It searches and returns text; it never changes data, never acts on your behalf, and does not read your conversation beyond the search query you ask it to run.

Coverage and limits: over 12,000 Supreme Court of India judgments from 2016 to 2026. High Court judgments, tribunals and earlier years are not included. The case summaries are AI-generated and can contain errors. Always read the source judgment before relying on a result in court or in advice. Pledr is a research tool and does not provide legal advice.

Sign in with Google or your email. Documentation: https://www.pledr.in/docs/ . Support: support@pledr.in .
defaultPrompt: Use Pledr Legal to find Supreme Court precedents on anticipatory bail after a charge-sheet is filed.
Use Pledr Legal to find what the Supreme Court has said about Section 138 of the Negotiable Instruments Act.
Use Pledr Legal to look up judgment 2018 INSC 880 and summarise what it held on privacy.
